name: Impacto Board
tagline: heditor's impacto: a calm board of navy cards on a gold seam, progressive word fill, two hard bursts per reel.

motion.direction: heditor `impacto`. A calm board: navy cards (`mar`) with a thin `goldd` border and one gold seam; text fills progressively, word by word, gold `ter` for the hook act and cyan `gold` for the explanation act (78 / 68 / 64 px by act). Exactly TWO hard emphasis bursts per reel (a `posterText` at 150 px that lands in 0.2 s) — everything else rises 0.4 s expo.out and fades 0.25 s. Lists as `chips`, numbers as `counter`, chapters as `chapterCard`. No slams, no stamps, no shakes; a visual change every 3–5 s.
